name: 2g MKX Disposable *LIMITED EDITION* WC26 - Valencia Kush - Sativa
description:
Inspired by the world’s favorite game, this limited-time release brings international flavor straight to the lineup. Three countries. Three unique flavor experiences. From Spain to the USA to the United Kingdom, each strain delivers its own signature profile — no passport required. Step up, tap in, and take your taste buds for a spin around the world.

Valencia Kush delivers an energizing, mood-boosting experience packed with bright citrus flavor and smooth herbal undertones. This sativa-forward strain sparks creative focus and uplifting euphoria while maintaining a balanced, easygoing body feel for all-day enjoyment. Tangy citrus notes blend with subtle diesel and earthy herbs for a bold, refreshing finish that keeps every hit flavorful and smooth.
Flavor Notes: Citrus, Diesel, Herbal
